record.title: Validate continuous execution after the two modeled reads
record.intent: Remove the proven post-store stop without losing bounded access observation or thread accounting.
requirements: Retain the two existing guarded main-thread responses and all-thread discovery and runtime event handling.
Add an explicit continuation mode that installs no post-store breakpoint and resumes all threads normally after the second response.
Private controls must store the composed value and then cause a third unsupported main-thread or worker mapped access.
Supply no response to either terminal access; capture fault and registers, quiesce the group, inspect state and reap all members.
Preserve the old positive and negative observer controls as regression checks with the rebuilt executable.
Classify nonmapped faults and unexpected signals separately; unknown events or exhausted bounds preserve a negative result.
acceptance: Independent checks validate exactly two responses, continuous execution, terminal thread attribution and the composed state in both continuation arms.
Preserve enforcement and system_server; commit and push the private conclusion before stock continuation.
